# Noji

> > Noji is a spaced repetition flashcard platform used by millions globally for language learning, exam preparation, and collaborative study across multiple languages and learning contexts.

Noji is a comprehensive digital flashcard application featuring spaced repetition and active recall techniques. The platform serves students, teachers, and language learners across 7+ languages with tools for deck creation, live collaboration, and adaptive learning.

## Key Topics

- Spaced repetition
- Flashcard app
- Active recall
- Language learning
- Exam preparation
- MCAT
- GRE
- USMLE
- Memory retention
- Collaborative learning
- Study tools
- Microlearning
- Deck creation
- Mobile app
- Educational platform

## Core Platform

- [Noji Flashcards: Create & Study in Noji App](https://noji.io): Noji flashcard app with spaced repetition used by 7M users
- [Flashcards for Students - Noji](https://noji.io/students): Noji flashcards for students with spaced repetition and MCAT prep
- [Flashcards For Teachers - Noji](https://noji.io/teachers): Noji flashcards for teachers with free tools for classroom learning
- [Flashcards for Language learners - Noji](https://noji.io/language-learners): Noji flashcards for language learning across Spanish, Japanese, Chinese
